author: sirdhov
body: Thats Ward build, great to survive but useless to deal damage. You should look for follower status % + bestial bond% like Gerd or Zagreus equipment. Osisris adorment would be nice to use in equipment and mnemosyne's one would be nice on a Celestial Lute. Also, some pets use elemental damage, so using equipments/relics that increases the element will increase the damage too.

author: SaswordC
body: Pretty decent imo. Go celestial Lute for more flexible pet if your survival is enough.
